note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 (independent auditor) after the user-namespace conversion (d8427e4380): the TestGatewayICMPTTLDiscard unit gained only `if !userns.Enter(t) { return }` as its first statement and its build tag moved from integration&&linux to linux. userns.Enter (internal/test/userns/userns_linux.go) re-runs the one named test in a fresh user+net+mount namespace and returns false to the parent only when the child reported PASS or SKIP; a failing child, a non-zero exit, or a child that ran nothing calls t.Fatalf, so every assertion below the guard still fails the test when the behaviour breaks. Body otherwise byte-identical. RFC 792 Time Exceeded: "If the gateway processing a datagram finds the time to live field is zero it must discard the datagram." Fresh judgement: TTL zero and TTL one must be absent on the routed exit and answered with Time Exceeded, while TTL two must forward on the same route, so a forwarding gateway fails. The discrimination record is a kernel-producer escape (ip_forward decides it from the packet alone): the test enforces the stack behaviour, but the row is published as escaped, not as proven by a break of Ze's code. Enforced.
